searchText: But with optimistic building they don't even validate the payload. I do believe that builders are not in the business of cheating proposers of their payment but I also agree with Dustin that this is a hole in the protocol the optimistic relaying mode insures against failure in that if you are not honest you lose your bond what exactly is the hole? we want a payment proof w/ the bid that a validator can independently verify? we could also do something simple in mev-boost itself where we query the balance of the fee-recipient before and after the proposed block and check if the difference is equal to the bid value right?
